claims.claim: On November 23 TSMC said advanced-process capacity remains short of demand and its long-term AI outlook stays positive.

claims.claim: Lenders are backing a $43 billion SpaceX Nvidia GPU deal structured so another company buys the chips and SpaceX pays quarterly, and they worry the collateral could end up in orbit.
claims.episode_span: Tom's Hardware reports lenders are backing SpaceX's $43 billion Nvidia GPU deal but worry the collateral could end up in orbit and be impossible to reclaim in a default.
claims.source_title: Lenders back SpaceX's $43 billion Nvidia GPU deal but worry the collateral could end up in orbit
claims.supporting_quote: The $43 billion loan is structured as a unique arrangement in which a different company buys the Nvidia chips, while SpaceX makes quarterly payments to use them.

claims.claim: SoftBank explored and then dropped active consideration of a $1 trillion buyout of SK hynix, a price 1.7 times a $577 billion valuation recorded November 20.

claims.supporting_quote: According to a report published in The Information on Friday (Nov. 20), SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son recently explored a $1 trillion buyout of SK Hynix.
